description: Vote choice in most recent presidential election
Task and profile identifier (e.g., '1.1' = task 1 profile 1; '1.2' = task 1 profile 2). 10 tasks x 2 profiles = 20 rows per respondent.

Forced-choice outcome: 1 = this profile was chosen by the respondent, 0 = the other profile was chosen. Derived from the Qualtrics CBC choice columns (Q31/Q33–Q36/Q39/Q41–Q44). Empty for 22 respondents (440 rows) whose raw Qualtrics responses could not be matched across available data extracts; exclude rows where chosen is empty for conjoint analysis.

Open-text response explaining why the respondent chose the candidate they selected in task 6 (Q40 in the Qualtrics survey). Non-empty only for rows where question_profile = '6.2' (task 6, profile 2 row). Empty string otherwise.
